issues_and_resolutions.issue: The Kimi ESLint configuration scanned generated .next output when lint ran after build.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex replaced the compatibility configuration with the native Next.js flat configuration and global generated-file ignores; build-then-lint now passes.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The Kimi dependency set used Next.js 15.5.2, which failed the production dependency security audit.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex upgraded Next.js to 16.3.3 and React to 19.2.8; the production dependency audit now reports zero vulnerabilities.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: At 375px the internal and external hero actions initially shared the same width.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex reduced the mobile external action to a secondary intrinsic width; the internal beginner-guide action is now uniquely largest at 375, 768 and 1440.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Kimi created transient node_modules, .next and local screenshot artifacts during candidate verification.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex integrated only approved source, configuration and design files; transient candidate artifacts were not copied to the formal repository.
